evidence.detail: R20 fixes rs/A/i as HotkeyListener. rs/l/f/j extends that exact class and is constructed only by OverlayRenderer.

OverlayRenderer passes RuneLiteConfig.x() as the keybind supplier; R17 fixes rs/s/h as RuneLiteConfig and x() is annotated dragHotkey / 'Drag Hotkey' / 'Configures the hotkey used to drag UI elements around'.
On hotkey press the listener sets an OverlayRenderer boolean true. On release it clears that flag and invokes the renderer's drag-state reconciliation method.
Exact-v308 class references show rs/l/f/j is referenced only by OverlayRenderer plus itself.

candidates.note: OverlayDragHotkeyListener is fixed by the reviewed HotkeyListener base, exact dragHotkey config metadata and exclusive OverlayRenderer state control. Confidence is 0.999.

evidence.detail: The class is a stateless static utility for drawing/filling Shapes, rendering outlined text and selecting the shared overlay border Stroke.
Its remaining static methods consume OverlayPosition plus Rectangle/Dimension state to adjust stacking rectangles and compute anchor offsets for fixed overlay positions.
Exact-v308 references are confined to Overlay and OverlayRenderer: the root delegates shared shape/text helpers to it and the renderer delegates OverlayPosition geometry to it.
The class has no subsystem/domain state; only static strokes, a translucent color and reusable rendering/positioning functions.

candidates.note: OverlayUtil is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for the framework's stateless drawing and placement helper. Confidence is 0.999.
